name: Rusted gallery key
description: Long as a finger and orange with rust, on a ring worn thin by a miner's belt. He kept it safe for years after he stopped remembering what it was for.
notes: The vertical slice's exit key (docs/design/vertical-slice.md B5, mw-e01.6): it opens the iron exit door's slice-exit lock straight from the keyring (mw-e17.5). A quest item, so it can't be dropped, thrown or sold and is never lost in the level; reusable, so it stays on the ring. The slice's Forgotten miner carries it (its scene spawn's carries) and drops it where it dies (mw-e01.5). Placeholder text until e39-item-creature-text.
